latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Scrapes every local business in any location and category using Apify.
- Runs a full health diagnostic for each business, covering website, SEO, reviews, and social presence.
- Calculates monthly revenue at risk and assigns an opportunity score for each business.
- Detects and ranks specific business gaps (e.g., no website, poor reviews, dead social).
- Generates outreach messages with revenue impact estimates tailored to each business.
- Produces a local market overview video via InVideo AI.
